ops.oldText: or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit
ops.newText: or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement and bound by confidentiality) to audit

ops.text: Audits shall be conducted no more than once per 12 months, and each audit shall be conducted off-site during Licensee's normal business hours and without access to Licensee's systems.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The audit right is currently unlimited in frequency, so we have capped it at no more than once per 12 months and added the standard hygiene of an off-site audit during business hours, no access to our systems, and a confidentiality-bound auditor. The existing 30-day written-request mechanic and the cost allocation (Licensor bears cost unless a 5% discrepancy) already work for us and are untouched.
proposal.summary: Cap audits at once per 12 months, off-site during business hours, by a confidentiality-bound independent auditor, with no access to Licensee systems.

mappings.element: No more than one audit per 12 months.

mappings.quote: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional

mappings.element: Audit at Vendor's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%.
mappings.quote: The cost of the audit will be borne by Licensor unless a discrepancy of more than five-percent (5%) is discovered

mappings.element: No direct access to Customer systems.
